description: Count job settings metadata rows grouped by node name, sorted from most common to least common.
request: select name, count(name) as count from jobs_jobsettingsmeta group by name order by count desc;

description: Count job settings metadata rows grouped by factory, sorted from most common to least common.
request: select factory, count(*) as factory_count from jobs_jobsettingsmeta group by factory order by factory_count desc;
